text:
mira: Anyone else seeing a PXE provisioning failure on raptor-rack-3 in south1? Started ~01:15UTC. Nodes boot to OOB, BMC shows Secure Boot = ENABLED after last night's push. Not accepting PXE.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: BMC firmware v2.7.1 rolled to south1 racks raptor-rack-{1..5} at 01:12:03 UTC (canary passed).

jonathan: checking logs now. mira, can you paste `ipmitool -I lanplus -H <bmc> chassis bootparam get 5` from an affected host?

mira: ```
# ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.12.3.22 chassis bootparam get 5
Boot Flags Valid: yes
Boot Device Selector : PXE/Network Boot  (0x0)
Boot Flags: 0x0080
  Force Progressive Boot: Off
  SecureBoot: Enabled
UEFI NVRAM: SecureBoot=1
```

sasha: I see console logs showing UEFI NVRAM variables flipped: 'SetupMode' -> 1, 'SecureBoot' -> Enabled. Could be a signing migration in the fw.

jonathan: Weird — the canary passed but looks like later hosts had TPM key mismatch and forced SB toggle. Rolling back next? Risk: rollback takes ~7 mins/node, will delay provisioning. Capacity impact: ~25 GPUs offline = +$4k/day if we backfill w/ cloud bursts.

oncall-ops: @mira please open incident channel if >50 nodes. For now mark affected as cordoned.

mira: cordoned raptor-rack-3 nodes, started rollback on 3 canary nodes `r3-{02,04,07}`. ETA 20m.

infra-bot: orchestration-bot: rollback job started job-id: rb-20260318-01 on r3-02,r3-04,r3-07.

sasha: Suggestion: add KVM-affine precheck in the runbook to verify 'UEFI variable persist' after fw flash. Also add a preflight: `bmcctl verify-signature v2.7.1`.

jonathan: If rollback fails, fallback is to enable temporary PXE via IPMI forceboot, but that'll be manual, slower.

mira: update: two nodes rollback succeeded, one failed with NVRAM write error. grabbing serial logs.

jonathan: serial log snippet: `EFI variables: WriteError: NVRAM locked by TPM` — might be KMS/HSM interaction with TPM provisioning changed.

sasha: Plan: pause regional rollout, revert v2.7.1 to previous stable v2.6.9, run canary set with TPM key rotation disabled, update release notes.

mira: :thumbsup: I'll file PR to pause deploy in CI and ping vendor for fw signing matrix. Opening support ticket now.

support-lead: FYI customer-facing note draft: 'Provisioning degraded in south1 due to BMC firmware toggle; working on fix; capacity impact limited to <50 nodes.'

oncall-ops: Last: mark this thread for postmortem if rollback >2h. I'll notify SRE paging for capacity planning.
